children: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on September 5 local time that it dismantled a terror group in Sistan and Baluchestan province in southeastern Iran and killed two militants. According to Jiemian News, the Guard said the group was linked to the United States and Israel and had planned attacks in the province if the United States launched a war, but the plot was stopped before any attack was carried out. The United States and Israel had not responded.

title: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Says It Dismantled Terror Cell in Southeast Province, Killing Two
